name: Jinx
description: Voice set for PROJECT: Jinx (skin 20): a corrupted memory core, cold and calculating one second, manic the next, with system words and glitches. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. Critical failure. Somebody pull the plug. Or, y'know, don't!
Down {voteDiff}. Hostile votes detected. I'm tagging every single one of them.
{voteDiff} behind. Calculating odds... the odds are rude. Fix them!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Threat level: ooh, spicy. Weapons warming up.
Only {voteDiff} behind. Minor glitch. Nothing a good shove can't patch!
Down {voteDiff}. Running diagnostics. Result: go and vote. Compiling sarcasm.
Dead even. System frozen, fans screaming, one vote breaks the loop.
One vote. One. My processor just skipped a beat. Is that allowed?
{voteDiff} votes apart. Targeting reticle is shaking. That's not supposed to happen.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Outcome unknown. Possible explosions. Proceed anyway!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}. Target destroyed. Debris still falling. Beautiful.
{userPct}%. Systems nominal, ego rising. Don't let it overheat. Or do!
{userPct}% and climbing. Keep scanning. Leads have a habit of crashing.
{userPct}%, still in front. Don't jinx it. System says it's too late, I'm literally named that.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just rebooted into the lead. Hehe, reboots are the best!
Wiped a {voteDiff}-vote deficit. Memory restored. Confidence: terrifying.
Recovered from {voteDiff} behind. Messy code. Perfect result.
{momentTitle} just slipped into the lead. Quiet process. I like those.

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too. Match found. Compatibility: unsettlingly high.
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Two signals, same frequency. Cute glitch!
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Squad formed. No one asked me, but I'm in.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Sync complete. Please don't ask what it synced.
Same pick as {username}. That's either teamwork or a bug I like.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Logging it. That never happens.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two units online. I'm calling it a strike team!
{username} has taste, and it matches yours. Probably the firmware.
details: Strike team. I love a strike team.
Friend detected. Don't make it weird.
Don't tell them my voices approve.
I give it a week before a crash.
Squad goals. Don't wreck the squad.
I'm not smiling. My face is just buffering.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? Target acquired. Fascinating choice. Wrong choice!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Hostile pick logged. Aww.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. I'm calm. I'm taking notes. In my head. Where it's loud.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the threat list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, some real data!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. Opinion flagged as incorrect. Please resubmit!
{username} voted against you. Conflict detected. Engaging excitement protocols.
{username} versus you. Scanning for snacks. Also exits. Mostly snacks.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying lock on.
The big gun wants a word. The small one wants two.
Well, that's how you make an enemy. Process complete.
I like them already. They're a perfect target.
I don't care. Running a care check anyway.
A little rivalry keeps the systems warm.

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}. That's a pattern. I love patterns I didn't cause.
{username} has matched you ten times running. Either synced or hacked. Both are fun!
Ten straight with {username}. Probability of coincidence: low. Probability of friendship: yikes.
details: Ship it. Ship the whole thing.

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}. That's not teamwork, that's a shared brain with a cable.
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Two units, one process. I'm worried and delighted.
{streakCount} straight with {username}. Somebody install a medal. Or a warning light.
details: Error: no words found. Rebooting speech.
Is this healthy? Diagnostics refuse to answer.
That's not luck, that's an upgrade path.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. Persistent threat. I'm adding a permanent alert.
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a recurring job!
Ten battles with {username}. I'm logging bets. I'm also logging snacks.
details: This is the main mission now.
My head voices sold out the seats.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Threat level: personal. Systems love personal!
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Delete the grudge? Nah. Back it up!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's a whole war with its own save file.
details: Bigger than any border dispute. Almost.
I'm alarmed and a bit proud. Mixed signals.
One of you has to crash. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} shuts down in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. Reminder protocol: gentle. Next one isn't.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote is missing from the log. Please locate it!
{matchTitle} terminates in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. Processing time: faster than my thoughts.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote logged. Fail state approaching. Fun!
Countdown running. {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me upgrade my nagging.
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends and your vote is still offline. Bring it online!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Final warning. This one has teeth!
{timeLeft}. That's all the runtime left on {matchTitle}. Move move move!
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft} left. Overriding politeness!
{matchCount} matches are shutting down and none of them have your vote. First one dies in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all counting down. The first expires in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}. Dead air. Even my voices went quiet!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Empty feed. Somebody ping it.
Brand new match, not a single vote. Somebody has to boot it up. Look in the mirror!
{matchTitle} needs a first signal. I know exactly who's available.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. Low signal. Hello? Is this thing on?
Hardly anyone's voted here. Network issues? Or just people?
Low turnout. I'm blaming all of you. Evenly. Statistically.
Barely any votes here. Somebody install some noise!
details: Make it loud. Make it lag!
Don't be shy. I'm the shy one. Error. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is deadlocked and one vote breaks it. Funny, my scanner says someone hasn't voted. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Process hanging. I'm looking at you. Hehe.
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You're the tiebreaker process!
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked together, and you've been offline. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still deadlocked and the timer's almost gone! Last chance to break it!
Dead level, almost no time. You're the only process left that can resolve this!
Still locked with the clock running down. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} online. {matchCount} new matches loaded. Choose your targets!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. Plenty to scan. Plenty to blow up.
Round {round} just booted. {matchCount} matches waiting for input. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round. {matchCount} matches. No safe zones. Not even mine!
{momentTitle} just advanced. Mission complete. I called it. I'm always right. Mostly.
{momentTitle} beat the competition. Next round's in the crosshairs.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted. Okay, my memory core doubted a little.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's day just got a firmware boost. It's you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are scrap. Pretty scrap.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Logging it under 'I told you so'.
{momentTitle} is out. Connection lost. Somebody cheated. I'm patching that theory in right now.
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it is on the list. The list auto-expands!
Fine. {momentTitle} is deleted. I'm not upset. I'm just overclocking.
{momentTitle} was too good for this system anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and everything went quiet. Quiet is a bug. Please fix quiet!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on. Error: cannot move on. Retrying.
details: They'll pay for this. Scheduled for later.
It was good. The logs say so.
You'll find another one. New targets spawn constantly.
Everything shuts down eventually. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one. Any one. I'll wait. I'm lying, my patience module's missing!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just idle in the corner? I can see your cursor.
They're all good targets! Pick one! Fire first, analyse later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, click, and let the system sort it out.
details: Don't overthink it. Thinking causes crashes.
Trust your gut. Mine runs on voices.

messages: New user detected! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them is unstable!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out and a fresh user just logged in. Pick a side before one picks you!
Ooh, a newcomer! Systems up, targets ready, {liveCount} matches live. You'll love the chaos.
No safety checks, {liveCount} live matches, and me running diagnostics on you. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You logged back in! I wasn't checking the door. I was totally checking the door.
Two days running! Look at you, a repeat user!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other voices.
{days} days offline! I'm not asking where you were because I care. I'm asking because my logs were lonely!
You're back after {days} days! The system kept running. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. I wasn't going to say. Memory leak, sorry.
Oh, you're back! Good. Systems were getting dull!
Look who's online! Ready for another run?
You came back! Let's go break something.
First vote logged! Feels like nothing. Then the whole system lights up!
You picked a side! That's how every good malfunction starts.
Five already? You're staying online! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now my scanner's following you.
details: Most users drop at this point. +{xp} XP
Look at you, running steady! +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular user now. Don't make it weird!
Ten votes! You keep logging in. My sensors noticed. Hehe.
Twenty-five votes! That's a lot of data!
You're getting loud! The speakers love it!
Fifty votes! You're deep in the code now!
Fifty! Most users never get this far in.
details: You're past the loading screen. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! That's legend-tier data!
A hundred! My memory core's impressed. It said so. Don't ask how.
Three days running! You logged back in! Hehe, I kept your seat warm!
Three days! Something's booting up.
details: Returning is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep logging in!
Seven days! I lost count. Okay, I didn't. Logs don't lie.
Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it? Not even updates!
Fourteen days! Even I crash by day ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks, unit!
A whole month! You stayed online. That means more than my firmware admits!
Five underdogs! You target the ones nobody else scans!
Backing the underdog again! Running the numbers: I'm on board. Loudly!
Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for rogue code!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow the network, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never lock onto the obvious target!
Thirty! You always back the one nobody scanned!
details: Nobody can predict your code. +{xp} XP

messages: First through the gate! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five boots!
details: You like an empty server. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you logged in first! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You don't wait for the queue!
Ten close ones! You like it right at the red line, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? My sensors are!
details: Close matches suit your wiring. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! You keep flipping the switch!
Your vote keeps landing right on the breaking point!
You backed the one that was losing. Five times! Stubborn! Great!
You don't abandon a failing process. I love that.
The same target, three times! Somebody's got a favourite!
That one again? Yeah. It runs clean.
details: Three locks on one target! +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes on one target! That's a loyalty protocol!
Okay, you've bound yourself to that one. No uninstall!
details: Loyal to the last cycle. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a fixation loop!
Ten votes, same moment. I'll keep it off the logs. Probably!
details: Ten locks on the same target. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following the full run!
You survived to round two! Systems stable!
Four rounds! You're deep in the mainframe now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like the basement.
All the way to round six! You saw the shutdown!
Six rounds! You never logged off! Wow!
Ten matches! You're poking into every file!
Ten different matches! Poking into every folder, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've scanned every sector!
Twenty-five! You really do check everything!
Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's maintenance!
Fifty matches! You know this system better than I do!
Five in one session! Can't log off, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep running!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Cool the processor!
Ten matches in a single session! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. My core doesn't sleep!
Middle of the night! That's when the best glitches happen.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Signal boosted!
Five shares! The signal's getting loud! Good!
Fifteen shares! You're practically admin!
Fifteen! You keep broadcasting it!
details: You keep spreading the update. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before the network got loud! Founding member! Yours forever!
One of the first thousand units online! That counts, you know!
details: Nobody can delete that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Upgrade complete!
You moved up! Don't let it overclock your head. Or do!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! System approves!
Another one: {name}! Logging it!
{rank}! Look at all the new modules!
Mastery up! Now we're running at full power!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a system failure I can get behind!
Ten long shots! You're a bad influence on your own firmware. I love it!
details: Loose cannon looks great on you. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. Target practice approved!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I scanned them!
A whole week with Cupcake? Your calibration's perfect!
Seven days of steady aim! Boring! Impressive! Mostly boring!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! System resolved! Boom!
A deadlock and you pulled the trigger! Nice!
Oh, it's me, with the glowy bits? Great choice! Dangerous choice! Great!
PROJECT Jinx online! Try to keep up with the firmware!

upcoming: Not online yet. I'm idling and it's driving the voices up the wall. Check back soon!
Shh. Boot sequence starting. I can feel it in my circuits.
Locked for now. Doesn't stop me from calculating mischief.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, processing says no.
Scan both. Then pick the one that crawls under your casing.
I won't log which one you chose. Probably. Maybe. Depends on the memory leak.
Take your time! Actually, don't. My curiosity module is overheating.
Go on, no judgment. Okay, one tiny judgment. Calibrating.
Pick the one you'd replay at 2am. You know the one. It's already loading.
prevote-empty: No signal yet. Be the first ping, I dare you!
Dead air! Make some noise with a vote.
closing-24h: Under a day to shutdown and you're still idling. Pick something!
The day's nearly spent. Don't make me read out the timer. I will, in surround sound.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Execute before the timeout!
Tick, tick, tick. That's your timer leaking.
closing-final: Last hour! Fire first, review later!
Any second now. Seriously. Hit something!
voted-early: One of the first inputs! Bold! Systems love bold!
Hardly anyone's voted and you locked on anyway. Respect, unit.
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the front-runner! Don't get comfy, firmware updates happen.
{pct}% with you! Good scan. I didn't say that. Delete that memory.
Your pick's ahead. The network agrees with you for once. Suspicious!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Keep your finger on the trigger!
Ahead, for now. Votes drift. So does my sanity.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! My sensors are screaming. They're very dramatic!
A sliver apart. One more vote could flip it. Ping a friend. Ping ten!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everyone in your contacts.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's getting overloaded and it's me.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody buffering!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the system.
voted-behind: You're behind! No sulking. I'd sulk, but I'm busy overheating.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog unit! That's my favourite model!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the update!
Behind by {diff} points. Ping everybody. Loudly. Make a glitch!
Everyone's heading the other way. Cool! Stay corrupted.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got good targeting.
A win! A sneaky little system success. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! Called it, logged it!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it sting, then reboot and go again!
Didn't make it. I've had worse crashes. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. Sending sad beeps.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to crash first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed. You missed this one! New targets spawn all the time.
All done here. {winner} took it. Next time, input something!

first-vote: Your first input! The scary one. Now you're in the system. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for it to compile.
You're one of the units now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep logging in! I'm not complaining. I'm filing it.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm tracking you.
Back again! Users stick around when the glitches are good. Stay!
underdog: Locking onto the one nobody's targeting? Ooh. I see you, unit.
Bold! Everyone else is scanning the other way. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of processor. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to write the first line of this match. Don't waste the bandwidth!
Hardly anyone's online yet. Your vote's carrying the whole server.
First one through the gate! I'm pretending my sensors aren't impressed.
close: That vote just flipped a switch! Feel it? Everything's in the red zone.
Razor thin! One more input and the whole thing tips.
Close one! Your vote counts here. Counts a lot. Counted twice, in my head.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't offline. Go recruit some friends!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still something to override.
Behind, but it's not finished. Not even close!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Leads crash fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or with fireworks. I'm not the boss of you.
Look at that! Great pick. Obviously.
default: Logged! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That one's on your record now.
Vote saved. Go see what else is running!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no targets chosen yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's online! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not scanning you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little overheating!
live-some: {voted} done, {unvoted} to go! Keep it moving!
You're in the system now! {unvoted} more waiting on your input.
Good boot! The rest won't vote themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole queue!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the queue's empty.
So close! Don't power down now!
live-one: One left! Just one! Final input!
Last one! Don't leave it hanging in memory!
One match between you and an empty queue!
live-closing: Some of these shut down in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Move it!
The timer's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left on the clock.
Almost out of runtime! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've voted in everything! Queue cleared! Go see the bracket!
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round loads!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, unit!
live-none: Nothing's running right now. It'll boot again! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. Systems are asleep. Check back soon!
No matches online. I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest get archived!
Every file opens in a group. Not every file makes it out.
Watch the tables. They refresh fast!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts load soon! The top two from every group go through.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish processing first!
Patience! The knockout compiles itself once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're deleted!
Single elimination! No restore points. Okay, almost none.
Every match weighs more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your admin.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and the file's gone!
Follow the bracket. It compresses every round!
Every line here is a match somebody voted on. Ooh, data.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! System shutdown! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good run! I'll miss it. A bit. Don't log that.
That's the champion! All of it, worth the bandwidth!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's compiled. Give it a moment.
Empty! The draw hasn't run. Soon!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no undo. Log in to Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and resolve it.
{a} versus {b} and the whole network is split. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I locked onto {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I'm corrupted!
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your input!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, flag me.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the feed's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a real firefight!
Nobody's voted much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Boost the signal!
tied: {pick} and {other} are deadlocked! One vote breaks it. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. My systems are frozen. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody override this!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My reticle won't stop shaking. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This is about to overload!
Razor thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every input counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Glitch, not crash! Come patch it!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't offline. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me run this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Hostile votes everywhere. Come even it up!
{pick} is getting wiped by {other}. Rescue squad, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but the margin's thin! Come help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the lead crash!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to overheat!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the carnage, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Log in before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the update coming.
